feat: quote_issue / quote_verify client methods (issue #28)
In exfer-stack/exfer-py, his own repository.
This pull request is merged.
https://github.com/exfer-stack/exfer-py/pull/1

Wave 2 (exfer-py half) of the EXFER-QUOTE standard (ahuman-exfer/exfer#28). Thin typed wrappers for the new walletd RPCs landed in exfer-stack/exfer-walletd#2.

## What
- `quote_issue` (Spend section) and `quote_verify` (Read section) on both `Client` and `AsyncClient` — params/results mirror the walletd wire shapes exactly (snake_case, method name maps directly, no transform).
- `QuoteJson` / `QuoteIssueResult` / `QuoteVerifyResult` TypedDicts in `types.py`; optional `payer_pubkey` / `reason` keys use `total=False` to match walletd's `skip_serializing_if = Option::is_none` (absent, not null).
- **No client-side scope enforcement** — scope is a server-side bearer-token concern; the client stays a thin wrapper.

## Tests
respx-mocked wire tests for both methods, sync + async. Unit suite green (**157 passed**). The 15 `tests/integration/*` errors are the pre-existing real-walletd-binary harness (needs `WALLETD_KEYSTORE_PASSPHRASE`), unrelated to this change.

## Follow-up
exfer-mcp re-pins to this commit to expose both as MCP tools (separate PR).
